name: BD+50 1471B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list XO-2 N and BD+50 1471B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 934346809278715776 and 934346740559239296), 4,677 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 1.1e-11: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to XO-2 N, 4,677 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 356473029 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 356473029 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: BD+50 1471B is a star of 5,547 K, bound to XO-2 N 4,677 AU away.
text.introduction: BD+50 1471B shares its motion through space with XO-2 N, 4,677 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: BD+50 1471B's orbit around XO-2 N is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
